name: Slumber
overview: Scripture contrasts God's vigilant care with human slumber, emphasizing that God neither slumbers nor sleeps as He faithfully protects His people (Psalms 121:3-4). Conversely, human slumber, especially when linked to slothfulness, is depicted as a hindrance to diligence and provision, leading to poverty and hunger (Proverbs 6:9-10; 19:15; 20:13). These verses call believers to awaken from spiritual and physical lethargy, trusting in God's unceasing watchfulness while actively pursuing faithful stewardship of their responsibilities.
